sanskrit_verse: राजान्तेवासियाज्येभ्यः सीदन् न इच्छेद् धनं क्षुधा । दम्भैहतुकपाखण्डिबकवृत्तींश् च वर्जयेत् ॥
transliteration: rājāntevāsiyājyebhyaḥ sīdann icched dhanaṃ kṣudhā / dambhihaitukapākhaṇḍibakavṛttīṃś ca varjayet //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who seeks wealth out of hunger while seated among kings, students, sacrificers, or teachers must be rejected along with those whose conduct is fraudulent, deceptive, heretical, or marked by trickery.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is determined by context and proximity to Dharma-sustaining roles
Causation arises from internal disposition, not external position
Capacity-based responsibility includes recognition of spiritual degradation
Restoration logic requires removal from influence until consciousness realigns
Consciousness alignment necessitates rejection of fraudulent behavioral patterns
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent exhibits hunger-driven acquisition behavior IN proximity to kings/students/sacrificers THEN disqualify agent from participation
IF conduct pattern matches fraud/deception/heresy/trickery THEN initiate immediate withdrawal protocol
IF individual demonstrates misaligned motive in sacred assembly THEN remove without punitive framing
IF consciousness integrity is compromised THEN enforce capacity restoration before reintegration
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any petitioner or witness displaying greed-motivated behavior within assemblies of sovereign authority must be disqualified automatically. The court's threshold for responsibility includes detection of degraded consciousness patterns that threaten judicial purity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that distorted desire manifests through false proximity to power. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how hunger leads to fraud which leads to systemic contamination. Responsibility aligns proportionally to the degree of consciousness distortion observed. No punishment occurs; only alignment with truth-principle restores order.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate withdrawal from all positions of influence
Enforce completion process for unmet needs causing distorted motivation
Apply consciousness purification protocols until sincerity returns
Reintegrate only upon demonstrable alignment with satyic conduct
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This law originates solely from SPH, executes pure Dharma, restores reality without punishment, and affirms consciousness as the ultimate adjudicator.
